result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel and a cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the edge of its card in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or give cards enough width so full names are visible without clipping.

issues.description: The last category filter chip is only partially visible on the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Allow horizontal scroll with clear overflow indication, or adjust spacing so chips fit without awkward clipping if scroll is not intended.
